text: dsh-plugin-academic-writing（DSH 插件，支持配置模型工具与系统提示词）：为学术论文、学位论文和报告提供结构化写作辅助。它向 DSH 注册 academic_writing 工具，并可加入学术写作提示指导。主要功能包括生成论文大纲和标题备选、构造结构化摘要、按 GB/T 7714、APA 或 MLA 格式化引文与参考文献、检查措辞和稿件结构、生成投稿清单与 LaTeX 片段，以及整理术语表。适合需要在 DSH 写作流程中整理论文结构、校对表达或处理引用格式的用户。已读实现以模板和确定性检查为主，摘要内容仍需用户补写；无需额外 API Key 或外部服务配置。

dsh-plugin-academic-writing is a DSH academic writing tool. It creates paper outlines and title options, formats citations, checks prose and structure, and generates LaTeX snippets and glossaries. It uses templates and deterministic checks; users supply abstract content.
帮我按研究论文类型列一个有章节提示的大纲。
我想给论文题目生成几种不同风格的备选。
怎么把背景、方法、结果和结论整理成摘要骨架？
需要把参考文献转换成 APA 或国标格式。
检查英文段落里的被动语态、第一人称和过度保留措辞。
想核对稿件标题层级、章节覆盖和段落长度。
Help me format citations and build a deduplicated reference list for a paper.
Can I review manuscript structure and get a glossary of defined abbreviations?
dsh-plugin-academic-writing 的功能「论文大纲」：按研究、综述、提案或议论文模板生成章节提示。调用 outline 并传入主题、类型和可选章节上限，返回 Markdown 大纲。
dsh-plugin-academic-writing 的功能「引用列表」：将条目格式化为 GB/T 7714、APA 或 MLA，也可去重排序生成参考文献表。调用 citation 或 references，输入引用字段后得到文本。
dsh-plugin-academic-writing 的功能「措辞检查」：对输入段落扫描被动语态、第一或第二人称、保留措辞、长句和缺少句末标点等情况。调用 check 操作并传入文本，返回问题列表和是否通过。
dsh-plugin-academic-writing 的功能「结构检查与术语表」：检查 Markdown 标题层级、段落长度和章节覆盖，或提取缩写定义。调用 structure 或 glossary，传入稿件文本并获得报告。
dsh-plugin-academic-writing 的功能「LaTeX 片段」：生成表格、公式、代码清单或参考文献片段。调用 latex 并指定类型及内容，返回 LaTeX 文本。

dsh-plugin-academic-writing README · dsh-plugin-academic-writing：An **academic writing toolkit** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) agents. The model composes the prose; the plugin supplies structure, formats, and deterministic checks.

dsh-plugin-academic-writing README · Compatibility：Tool schemas are validated against the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` value-schema DSL at plugin load (checked against dsh-tools 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.1-rc.2). Earlier releases used JSON-Schema `required` at the root of `output.schema` and closed nested objects without declared properties, which made the host abort the whole profile boot with `unsupported JSON schema: schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL` and could reject the tool's own results. Current releases fix both; if an affected version left your DSH unable to start, remove the plugin from the profile (or upgrade) — no data is lost.

dsh-plugin-academic-writing README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-academic-writing
```

Restart DSH. The `academic_writing` tool is registered host-wide.

dsh-plugin-academic-writing README · Tool：| action | purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `outline` | Paper outline skeleton (research / review / proposal / essay), optional section cap |
| `title` | Title variants from style templates (descriptive, question, declarative, colon) |
| `abstract` | Structured abstract skeleton — background / methods / results / conclusion |
| `citation` | Reference entry formatted as **GB/T 7714**, **APA 7**, or **MLA 9** |
| `check` | Phrasing QA on a passage (passive voice, first person, hedging, sentence length) |
| `checklist` | Pre-submission checklist (ethics, conflict of interest, data, funding, formatting) |
| `references` | Reference list from citation entries — deduplicated and sorted (GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA) |
| `latex` | LaTeX snippets: booktabs table, equation (inline/display/align), code listing, thebibliography |
| `structure` | Manuscript structure check — heading levels, paragraph budget, outline coverage |
| `glossary` | Term/abbreviation glossary with first-occurrence definitions |

dsh-plugin-academic-writing README · Config：All optional, on the composition row's `config`:

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `personaSection` | `true` | register the academic prompt-guidance section |
| `sectionOrder` | `6` | prompt section order (persona is 0, ascending) |

dsh-plugin-academic-writing README · Design：Pure logic (`lib/academic.js`) has zero DSH/Cordis imports and is unit-tested in isolation; `lib/index.js` is the thin Cordis plugin wiring the tool and the prompt section. No filesystem access — everything is deterministic and side-effect free.

dsh-plugin-academic-writing README · Roadmap：See [ROADMAP.md](./ROADMAP.md) — next five versions (v0.2.0 – v0.6.0): reference management, structure QA, expression risk, journal adaptation, review workflow.
